name: domain-atlas-issuer-demo
description: Minimal real issuer for the Example Plaza demo domain — generates a real ECDSA P-256 keypair, signs domain-atlas-asset/1.0 credentials, and serves the .well-known files a verifier fetches. Zero dependencies (Node's built-in http/crypto only) — nothing to npm install. Replaces the plain static server on port 8001 for demo-domain-a only; demo-domain-b stays a plain static server on purpose, to prove it needs no special integration with the issuer to verify what it hands out.
